notes.title: Major Update: totorial storyline. Join the latest playtest!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42814198/6a4777697b2998d9e61bbb7b759df8b647730c97.jpg

Greetings!
We’re thrilled to announce that Ars Notoria will be showcased at the Eastern Game Fest! This event marks an exciting opportunity for players to dive into the mystical world we’ve been refining since our last playtest.

What’s New?
Since our previous test, we’ve implemented numerous optimizations and gameplay enhancements based on community feedback. Today, we’re proud to reveal that Ars Notoria will host a limited-time PlayTest during the Eastern Game Fest!

PlayTest Details & Key Updates

 Test Period
April 23rd – May 6th (PDT)

 How to Participate
If you’re interested in joining the PlayTest, we invite you to fill out the registration form. Eligible players will be contacted promptly. You can also sign up for the Playtest through Steam’s “Request Access” feature. However, please note that we are unable to control which players get selected via the Steam platform. Registration Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc2kQ1yFc0QVi5bFMOq92d6glksHjSUIp-KWgypvSIvIR-1tA/viewform?


 Major Additions & Improvements

Training Camp Story Arc
A brand-new storyline set in the Training Camp is now available. It introduces the Holy Guard faction, along with unique NPCs, quests, and an expanded area for exploration. We've also added daily routines for most characters, new dialogues, and additional interaction options to enrich the experience.

Character Switching Mechanics
Progressing through the main Training Camp quests unlocks new mechanics that let you form a squad of up to four characters, allowing you to switch between them freely—both during combat and while exploring.

Combat Classes
After completing basic combat training at the camp, you'll gain access to six combat classes. These classes offer new ways to develop and customize your character's abilities and playstyle.

Waystones
Waystones are magical structures that enable fast travel between locations. We've also added an option to return to your selected respawn point via the World Map. Fast travel is enabled by default, but customizable settings are available when starting a new game, allowing you to disable or adjust how it functions.

Notice Boards
Found in settlements and outposts, notice boards offer access to side quests given by nearby NPCs.

Reputation & Approval Systems
With the introduction of the Holy Guard faction and new characters, we’ve implemented faction reputation and character approval systems. These affect faction management progression and influence character recruitment.

Quality-of-Life Improvements
Based on feedback from previous testing phases, we’ve added several improvements to enhance gameplay, including:
1. The ability to block enemy attacks while using ranged weapons
2. Map indicators for hard-to-find quest objectives
3. The option to harvest wood from small shrubs
4. Increased speed for manual resource gathering
5. Improved stability and the ability to load backup saves of your game world

Character Customization
The new version offers expanded character customization options, including beards, mustaches, and face and body tattoos.

New Items and Equipment
The Training Camp also introduces new items and rewards. You can also earn a unique armor set by completing optional objectives during training quests.


Join the Mystical Journey!
This PlayTest offers a chance to experience Ars Notoria’s evolving world firsthand. Whether you’re a returning player or a newcomer, your feedback will shape the path to perfection.
Thank you for your support, and see you at the Eastern Game Fest! 
Join our official Disocord: https://discord.gg/bYNb6kmw

— The Ars Notoria Dev Team

notes.title: Faction Management Update
notes.notes:
Quests

 Added a continuation to the Missing Villagers main quest. 
Since there are changes to the quest's implementation, its state will be reset in existing save games.
 Added more quests to the Destroyed Village questline:
[olist]
 New Beginnings
 The Broken Mill
[/olist]
 Fixed an issue where Missing Villagers quest progress might not be properly saved.
 Fixed an issue where dialogue with the rescued villager couldn't be initiated in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where rescued villagers might respawn in imprisoned state after loading the game.
 Fixed an issue where the progress of certain intermediate tasks in quests was not saved properly.

Factions

 Added the Faction Management system.
 The main character can create a faction after rescuing villagers during the "Missing Villagers" quest.
 Faction members can be assigned workplaces and given tasks.

Tutorials

 Added tutorials for the Faction Management system.

Prebuilt Houses

 Destroyed village houses can now be rebuilt through the Faction Management system.
 Rebuilt houses can be upgraded with various furniture and equipment.
 Faction members can be assigned to live in the rebuilt houses.
 Fixed an issue where prebuilt houses could be entered by clicking on any part of the building, instead of only the door.
 Fixed an issue where tables in prebuilt houses had an incorrect offset from the floor.

Character Customization

 Added an option to change the character's appearance in-game by using Wardrobe furniture.
 A faction member's appearance can be customized once they are assigned housing with a wardrobe.
 Fixed an issue where NPC portraits in the dialogue UI could display incorrect clothing colors.
 Fixed an issue where character customization slider values might not be loaded correctly when modifying an existing character.
 Fixed an issue where hair color could reset when switching between different hairstyles.
 Fixed an issue where editing an existing character's hair or clothing color wouldn't update until the style was switched.

Resources

 Fixed an issue where resource deposits might not be detected by the auto-harvesters upon placement, requiring re-entering the dungeon to start production.
 Fixed an issue where plantable crops could not grow on Flat Ground modules.
 Fixed an issue where honey could only be collected from one buildable beehive per day.

Building

 Added Engineer's Workbench which unlocks Woodcutting, Mining, and Quarrying research projects.
 Multiple processing tools can now be placed near a productivity tool (for example, several Circular Saws near a Debarker), but by default, only one will receive the bonus. 
With the corresponding technology research, all of them will receive productivity bonuses.
 Added arrow indicators to show if the build part is within the range of an automation tool when placed.
 Added buildable fences:
[olist]
 Old Fence
 Log Fence
 Farm Fence
 Wattle Fence
 Small Fence
 Picket Fence
 Iron Fence
[/olist]
 Added new buildable furniture and decorations:
[olist]
 Cotton Curtains
 Round Rug
 Flower Boxes
 Door Lock
 Shutters
 Small Desk
 Wardrobe
 Bookcase
[/olist]
 Lanterns for village houses now also require the Oil resource.
 Stone ovens now also require the Fuel resource.
 Building within the Destroyed Village zone is now possible.
 Tile Mold tool was renamed to Tile Press.
 Fixed an issue where the craftable bed required fabric materials of an incorrect rarity level.
 Fixed an issue where furniture objects might not refund the full amount of building materials upon destruction.
 Fixed an issue where the built stone oven could disappear after reloading the game.

Research

 Added Engineer research functionality. 
Research grants bonuses to various harvesting and crafting professions.
 Constructing multiple research tools of the same type increases the global research speed for corresponding projects. 
For example, building additional Engineer's Workbenches boosts the research speed for Woodcutting, Mining, and Quarrying projects.
 Rebalanced the maximum productivity of non-upgraded automation tools to align with research project bonuses. 
Previously, most tools had a maximum productivity of 400%, but now they start at 200% and can increase up to 400% through the corresponding research.
 Woodcutting research projects:
[olist]
 Whipsaw - Increases the base processing speed of soft lumber by 50%.
 Tar Refinery - Increases the base processing speed of pitch by 50%.
 Logging Wheel - Increases the base storage capacity for softwood by 25.
 Lumber Rack - Increases the base storage capacity for soft lumber by 25.
 Tar Tank - Increases the base storage capacity for pitch by 25.
 Log Splitter - Allows connecting multiple processing tools of each type to Debarkers.
 Log Flume - Increases the maximum productivity of Sawmills by 100%.
[/olist]
 Mining research projects:
[olist]
 Ingot Mold - Increases the base processing speed of iron ingots by 50%.
 Ventilation - Increases the base harvesting speed of copper ore by 50%.
 Wheelbarrow - Increases the base storage capacity for iron ore by 25.
 Foundry - Increases the base storage capacity for copper ore by 25.
 Iron Works - Increases the base storage capacity for iron ingots by 25.
 Ore Loader - Allows connecting multiple processing tools of each type to Stamp Mills.
 Mine Hoist - Increases the maximum productivity of Drainage Pumps by 100%.
[/olist]
 Quarrying research projects:
[olist]
 Plug and Feather - Increases the base processing speed of sandstone by 50%.
 Crane - Increases the base harvesting speed of peat by 50%.
 Stone Sled - Increases the base storage capacity for sandstone by 25.
 Block Lift - Increases the base storage capacity for sandstone blocks by 25.
 Minecart - Increases the base storage capacity for peat by 25.
 Stone Cutter - Allows connecting multiple processing tools of each type to Stone Saw Machines.
 Gyratory Crusher - Increases the maximum productivity of Rock Crushers by 100%.
[/olist]

Equipment

 Fixed an issue where Archon Boots applied healing on attacks instead of evasion.

User Interface

 Added a minimap icon for the player's mount.
 Slightly reordered harvesting skills, placing the Farming skill higher on the list to better match the unlock and research order.
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial window could be opened while in the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where ability or spell quickslots were not removed from the quickslot panel after being dragged out and switching panels.
 Fixed an issue where the build part customization menu could remain open after destroying an object or returning to the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where minion command quickslots might not highlight upon activation in certain cases (e.g., after closing the Inventory menu).
 Fixed an issue where selecting a cooking recipe with missing resources, then canceling the cooking process, could add an extra ingredient to the inventory.

Other

 Fixed an issue where Cutthroat bandits could wear a helmet instead of a mask.

Hotfix 1

 Disabled character portrait animations as they may negatively affect performance.
 Fixed an issue where Backpacks and Tool Bags only had 30 slots unlocked instead of 60.
 Fixed an issue where wheat was consumed by the Manger tool even when leather or fat storage was full.
 Fixed an issue where the Manger's interaction with the Leather Rack and/or Stove could produce an incorrect amount of resources.
 Fixed an issue where Leather Rack and Stove production might not automatically resume after reloading the game.
 Fixed an issue where the resource icon in the harvesting tools UI could be dragged with 0 resource quantity and disappear afterward.

notes.title: Summoning Update
notes.notes:
Magic

 Added new magic glyphs: Touch and Raise Undead.
Touch glyphs can be obtained by defeating Enthralled Foxes, and Raise Undead glyphs can drop from Skeleton Mages.

Dungeons

 Added minimaps for dungeons.
 Added the ability to place build parts inside dungeons. For example, you can build auto-harvesters near resource deposits in dungeons.
 Increased the default dungeon length from 10 to 14 modules for Caves and from 16 to 20 modules for Mines.
 Defeated enemies inside dungeons now respawn after two in-game days.
After clearing the dungeon and re-entering, you may still encounter a few enemies because not all of them spawn at once.
 Resources harvested in dungeons now have the same respawn time as deposits outside, and they are affected by harvesting abilities that increase formation speed.

Treasures

 Added treasure maps that provide hints on how to find hidden treasures.
 Added more types of items that can be found in treasures.
 Adjusted reward scaling from treasure-related skills.
 Hidden treasures can now be dug up without learning the Treasure Hunt skill.

Units

 Skeletons now drop additional loot: Rusty Claymore, Ancient Sword, Ancient Shield, Ancient Dagger, Chaos Staff, Cursed Talisman.
 Added summonable minions:
[olist]
 Skeleton (Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Bloody, Hallowed) - can be summoned using the corresponding Raise Skeleton spell.
 Golem (Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Bone, Hallowed) - can be summoned using the corresponding Raise Golem spell.
[/olist]
 Minion strength depends on the following parameters:
[olist]
 The minion's level and attributes are increased by 1 for every 2 Intelligence points of the caster.
 The minion's base damage is increased by 10% for each Intensity point of the summoning spell.
 The minion's bonus health is increased by 10% for each Magnitude point of the summoning spell.
 The minion's movement speed is increased by 2.5% for each Momentum point of the summoning spell.
[/olist]
 Minions can now apply effect buildups. Summoned skeletons and golems deal physical damage, but their applied effect buildup depends on their elemental type.
 Minions are teleported to the main character if the distance between them is greater than 30 meters.
 Added Enthralled variations for foxes.
 Added a trophy for defeating Skeleton enemies.
 Added a trophy for defeating foxes.
 Enthralled deer can now cast Elemental Orb spells.
 Increased the area of effect for the Skeleton Mage's ability, Chaos Explosion, by 25%.
 Fixed an issue where buildup effects could be applied to training dummies and shooting targets.
 Fixed an issue where unit navigation might stop working in certain cases.

Mounts

 Wild horses are now spawned with random colors (White, Palomino, Brown, Gray, Dark Gray, or Black).
 Increased the number of item slots provided by saddlebags from 18 to 30.
 Fixed an issue where taming a new horse while already having one could overwrite some of the previous data, such as affection value or leveling info.

Inventory

 Added four equipment slots for utility items such as Bags or Wearable Lanterns.
 Fixed an issue where an incorrect item might get removed from the inventory in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where equipping an item from a quickslot wouldn't work after loading a game until the item was re-equipped in the inventory.
 Fixed an issue where using a consumable item from a quickslot might cause the item quantity in the inventory to change incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where dragging an item into quickslot could override consumable item uses.
 Fixed an issue where the last stack of an item wasn't consumed when used from a quickslot.
 Fixed an issue where quickslot item parameters (such as quantity, charges, quality, etc.) might not get updated.
 Fixed an issue where the item quickslot wasn't removed from the panel after salvaging the item.

Crafting

 Added craftable Tool Bags that have 60 inventory slots and provide bonus experience to harvesting skills. 
They also have a function to automatically store all tools. It's disabled by default but can be toggled by clicking a small button in the top-right corner of the equipped item icon.
 Added craftable Belt Pouches that have 30 inventory slots and grant a bonus duration for consumables. They also have a function to automatically store consumables.
 Added craftable Backpacks that have 60 inventory slots and grant a chance to find additional loot when equipped. They also have a function to automatically store equipment, such as weapons and armor.
 Added Wearable Lanterns that can be attached to the character's belt.
 Added a crafting recipe for Claymore. It can be unlocked after salvaging a Rusty Claymore looted from Skeletons.
 Fixed an issue where crafting recipes might not unlock after obtaining the prerequisite resource in certain cases.
 Fixed an issue where the Cure crafting recipe was missing the Red Mushroom ingredient.

Building

 Added buildable ladders for storage platforms.
 Added buildable beehives. The crafting recipe is unlocked after obtaining Royal Jelly, which has a 25% chance to be found while collecting honey from wild nests.
 Added buildable storage for seeds. It is available under the Farming > Utilities tab and can be unlocked after discovering Lumber.
 Adjusted placement collision on large build parts (such as auto-harvesters) to make them easier to place.

Cooking

 Selecting a recipe from the cookbook will now automatically detect available food ingredients from bags and nearby containers.
 Fixed an issue where automatic ingredient selection might choose item stacks with lower quantities instead of the largest ones.

User Interface

 Added a pause button.
 Added a button to return to the main menu.
 Added a progress bar indicator to the game world loading screen.
 Added the functionality to switch between multiple quickslot panels (up to 9). The default keybinding for switching panels is Mouse Wheel Up/Down.
 Added a new Journal tab, "Summoning," which contains information about minions.
 Added bestiary entries for Skeleton enemies.
 Added a Nutrition parameter to the Detailed Stats, indicating when the character might develop a disease such as Scurvy.
 Portraits and health bars of active minions are now displayed beneath the main character's health bar.
 Character and world selection menus now use alphabetical ordering.
 Fixed an issue where some bestiary entries might contain incorrect information after switching between them.
 Fixed an issue where character selection context menus might have incorrect offsets.
 Fixed an issue where the Quickslot panel couldn't be interacted with while the Journal was open.
 Fixed an issue where some recipe unlocks might be displayed multiple times.

Settings

 Added support for Intel XeSS. It requires DirectX 12 and Windows 11 or Windows 10 64-bit, version 20H2 or newer.
 Added an option to rebind keys for switching quickslot panels.
 Added an option to skip empty quickslot panels when scrolling.
 Changed the default key binding for camera zoom from Mouse Wheel to Alt + Mouse Wheel.
 Adjusted slider step size for changing the FPS limit.
 Fixed an issue where the Magic Arts hotkey was not reset to the default value when the corresponding option was selected in the Settings menu.
 Fixed an issue where remapping a key to the Mouse Wheel could be overridden by scrolling.

Save Games

 Fixed an issue where the game might crash on load when certain plants or deposits were harvested.
 Fixed an issue where the character could spawn inside a foundation or other building part if the game was saved while the character was standing on top of it.

Audio

 Added sound effects to various enemy attacks.
 Added a sound effect for the torch attack.
 Fixed an issue where character footstep sounds didn't play when staff was equipped.
 Fixed an issue where footstep sounds might not play for some enemies.

Other

 Updated NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR versions.
 Fixed an issue where the RHI thread wasn't enabled by default when using DirectX 11.
 Fixed an issue where the sword weapon trail might have the incorrect type.
 Fixed an issue where a newly unlocked cooking recipe couldn't be selected in the cookbook until the Cooking Menu was reopened.

Hotfix 1

 Fixed an issue where exiting the Settings menu while the game is paused didn't reopen the pause menu.
 Fixed an issue where the auto-save timer was working while the game was paused, which might lead to incorrect save files.

notes.title: Magic System Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've uploaded the demo update that adds the magic system to the game. It includes the new Enchanter crafting class with the corresponding equipment. There are also new variations of enemies that have elemental magic and drop spellcrafting materials when defeated.

We plan to add more types of spells and their modifications in the upcoming patches, including summoning magic.

Here is the full list of changes in the update:

Magic System

 Added six Magic Arts:
[olist]
 Ars Goetia - fire magic that is focused on attacking spells and boosting the character's parameters.
 Ars Theurgia - frost magic that is focused on defensive spells and slowing enemies.
 Ars Paulina - poison magic that is focused on dealing damage over time and debilitating enemies.
 Ars Almadel - lightning magic that is focused on high burst damage and AoE spells.
 Ars Necromia - chaos magic that is focused on summoning and durability spells.
 Ars Notoria - holy magic that is focused on healing, dispelling, and utility spells.
[/olist]
 Added basic craftable and customizable spells for all Magic Arts.
 Added perks unlocked by leveling Magic Arts. They can provide various bonuses to selected spells.
 Added a Magic Sigil which allows slotting spells and perks to improve their efficiency.
 Added adjustable spell parameters:
[olist]
 Intensity - each point changes parameters like spell damage, minion strength, or barrier amount by 5%.
 Magnitude - each point changes parameters like maximum projectile range, size, or AoE by 10%.
 Momentum - each point changes parameters like speed, duration, or tick rate by 10%.
 Efficiency - each point changes parameters like spell cost by 7.5%.
[/olist]
 Added materials for spell crafting: Soul Shards, Glyphs, and Runestones.

Combat

 Added a hotkey for toggling aiming mode, defaulted to "F" button. It can be remapped in the Settings. 
This feature enables aiming mode even when using melee weapons, making it useful for spell casting.
 Increased the base Focus Regeneration value from 0.3 to 0.8 FP/sec.
 Significantly reduced the casting delay for Strong Attacks, making them execute almost immediately.
 Further reduced delays after executing Fast Attacks by 0.1 to 0.2 seconds.
 Parrying can now also be activated while blocking by pressing RMB again. The parrying window has been increased.
 Increased the base value of Physical and Elemental Block from 30% to 50%.
 Removed staggering from enemy Fast Attacks.
 Added buildup status effects:
[olist]
 Bleeding - Periodically deals damage based on the target's current health and reduces health regeneration.
 Stunned - Stuns the target for a short period of time and increases the poise damage.
 Ruptured - The target receives damage while moving, which scales based on the distance traveled.
 Staggered - Knocks down the target for a short period of time and reduces the resistance to staggering.
 Burning - Deals damage over time and increases delays between enemy attacks.
 Frozen - Freezes the target for a short period of time and then slows down attack and movement speed.
 Poisoned - Reduces enemy damage and inflicts damage that gradually increases over time.
 Shocked - Increases the critical hit chance against the target and slows down stamina and focus regeneration.
 Frightened - The enemy has reduced physical resistances and a chance to fumble an attack, dealing only half of the damage.
 Purged - Removes a positive effect from the target and temporarily increases all damage received.
[/olist]
 Added immunity to bleeding for Undead enemies.
 Fixed an issue where the enemy Charge attack might not be executed.
 Fixed an issue where attacks or hotkeys might not work after being staggered by an enemy in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where enemy attacks could consume more stamina than intended.
 Fixed an issue where negative resistances might not increase the damage received.
 Fixed an issue where enemy rotation might be incorrect while casting spells.

Enemies

 Added enemies with magic abilities that drop materials for spellcrafting when defeated.

Quests

 Added a tutorial quest for basic magic usage.
 Implemented additional checks to ensure that the Harvesting Resources quest is always received.
 Fixed an issue where disabling tutorial pop-up windows before starting a new game could prevent the initial tutorial quest from appearing.

Inventory

 Fixed an issue where equipped items weren't dropped on the ground when they were unequipped and the inventory was full.

Places of Interest

 Added Shrines containing elemental Soul Shards and granting blessings that increase experience gained in Magic Arts.
 Fixed an issue where some Places of Interest might have incorrect respawn times.

Resources

 Added harvestable Enchantment Crystals, which can be used to craft Enchanter's equipment. When harvested, these crystals will respawn after some time.
 Automation tools now provide harvesting experience for each collected resource.
 Fixed an issue where Stove resource processing was interrupted after the first 2-3%.

Crafting

 Added a new craftable item type: Elemental Staves.
 Fixed an issue where upgrading an item that was assigned to a quickslot might cause the upgrades not to apply.
 Fixed an issue where crafting an item while having a similar one in a quickslot might not update the quantity correctly.

Building

 Added Enchanter's tools:
[olist]
 Spellcrafting Workbench - allows creating new magic spells.
 Arcane Sphere - allows to apply modifications to spells.
 Melting Reservoir - allows salvaging materials from existing spells.
 Mystic Reliquary - allows adjusting spell parameters.
 Enchanting Table - allows enchanting basic equipment such as weapons, armor, and accessories.
 Rune Altar - allows to add extra effects to spells.
[/olist]
 Reduced the building cost of wood and stone foundations from 5 to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of floors and triangle foundations from 3 to 1.
 Reduced the building cost of wood walls from 4 lumber to 2, and from 3 clay to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of short walls from 2 lumber to 1.
 Reduced the building cost of door and window frames from 5 lumber to 4.
 Reduced the building cost of wood stairs from 5 to 3.
 Reduced the building cost of thatch roofs from 4 grain to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of corner thatch roofs from 5 grain to 3, and from 3 lumber to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of inner corner thatch roofs from 6 grain to 4, and from 4 lumber to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of flat thatch roofs from 4 grain to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of triangle thatch roofs from 3 grain to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of cobblestone from 2 to 1.
 Increased the building cost of wood doors from 3 to 4.
 Fixed an issue where some building materials, such as animal hides, might be displayed as missing even when there are sufficient quantities.

User Interface

 Unlocked the Magic Arts tab.
 Added a hotkey for opening the Magic Arts menu ("N" by default). It can be remapped in the Settings.
 Added bestiary entries for Enthralled enemies.
 Fixed an issue where two-handed weapons didn't occupy the off-hand slot after loading the game.
 Fixed an issue where swapping an item quickslot with an ability quickslot might cause the ability icon to disappear.
 Fixed an issue where a notification about not having enough Stamina wasn't displayed when ammunition was enabled.

Audio

 Added sounds for error messages regarding missing Stamina and Focus.

Settings

 Fixed an issue where custom camera offsets might not be loaded in some cases.

Hotfix 1

 Added a new tutorial video that shows how to collect Enchantment Crystals.
 Fixed an issue where the Magic Basics quest objectives weren't auto-completed if they were done before receiving the quest.
 Fixed an issue where, in some cases, dungeon walls could be generated in a way that led to the character getting stuck.
 Fixed an issue where the rifle's melee attack also consumed ammunition.
 Cooldowns for collecting resources from animals are now reset after switching to a new game world.
 Fixed an issue where items in prebuilt houses would respawn after re-entering them.
 Fixed an issue where items stored in prebuilt containers (inside farms or in the destroyed village) weren't saved.
 Fixed an issue where resource containers (baskets or sacks) in the destroyed village respawned after reloading the game.
 Fixed an issue where element selection buttons in the Bestiary were not reset after switching between enemy types.
 Removed the console key mapping from Num 0. The console can still be opened using the Tilde button (~).
